name: moonlight
title: Moonlight
description: Start Moonlight game streaming sessions on your paired hosts
author: MartinLoeper

commands.name: start-stream
commands.title: Show Streams
commands.description: List the apps of your paired Moonlight hosts and start streaming one

preferences.name: moonlightPath
preferences.title: Moonlight Binary
preferences.description: Name or absolute path of the moonlight-qt executable

preferences.name: configPath
preferences.title: Moonlight Config File
preferences.description: Path to Moonlight.conf. Leave empty to auto-detect (native, then Flatpak).

preferences.name: serverInfoTimeout
preferences.title: Host Status Timeout (seconds)
preferences.description: How long to wait for a host's status, e.g. 1.5. Leave empty for 3 seconds (allowed range 0.5 to 30)

preferences.name: showHidden
preferences.title: Hidden Apps
preferences.label: Show Hidden Apps
preferences.description: Also list apps that are marked as hidden in Moonlight

preferences.name: resolution
preferences.title: Resolution
preferences.description: Stream resolution passed to moonlight stream

preferences.name: fps
preferences.title: Frame Rate
preferences.description: Stream frame rate (e.g. 60). Leave empty to use the Moonlight default

preferences.name: bitrate
preferences.title: Bitrate (Kbps)
preferences.description: Video bitrate in Kbps (e.g. 20000). Leave empty to use the Moonlight default

preferences.name: quitAfter
preferences.title: Quit App After Stream
preferences.description: Whether to quit the app on the host when the stream ends
